title: dynamic-batching-seqlen-bucketing-padding-heuristics-v9: refine bucketing thresholds and kernel selection
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: reduce wasted padding and improve kernel selection for short- and mixed-length workloads without regressing p95 for long sequences. This PR iterates on our dynamic batching-by-sequence-length heuristics (v9): 1) a quantile-based bucketing strategy that adapts bucket thresholds per-server based on recent request length distributions; 2) an intra-bucket padding minimizer that allows limited intra-batch reordering to pack sequences with minimal padding while maintaining KV-cache locality; 3) a lightweight kernel selector hint that prefers fast short-seq kernels when average seq len in a batch is < 64 tokens and fallbacks to main kernels for longer cases. Changes are conservative and gated behind runtime feature flags so we can A/B and rollout gradually. Performance summary: up to 18% GPU utilization improvement on mixed chat workloads, 9-12% p95 end-to-end latency reduction for mixed-length traffic, and end-to-end token padding reduced by ~24% on average in our internal synthetic 60/30/10 short/med/long split. Backwards compatibility: defaults keep existing behavior; enabled via config flags: DYN_BATCH_SEQLEN=enabled, BUCKET_QUANTILES=0.5,0.75,0.9, PAD_REORDER_WINDOW=4. Includes updated unit and integration tests, perf benchmarks, and docs.

discussion: Miguel Ortiz (2025-11-14): Can you quantify how often the intra-bucket reordering will evict KV cache entries for multi-turn chat? We need numbers to accept the tradeoff.

Asha Patel (2025-11-14): Measured on a 48-hour trace: reordering window=4 evicts <0.8% of active KV entries compared to baseline. Evictions are concentrated on very long tails. Added metric emitters for kv_evictions_per_reorder to help monitor.
Samantha Lee (2025-11-16): Please add a safety check that disables packing when active KV size > 90% of allotted cache memory to avoid noisy evictions. Also request unit test for that code path.
Asha Patel (2025-11-16): Added safety check and unit test. Behavior: packing disabled and a metric "packing_disabled_high_kv_usage" emitted. Updated tests/unit/test_bucketing.py.

Ethan Zhao (2025-11-20): Benchmarks look promising. Two nits: 1) clarify config names in docs, 2) prefer making kernel hint decision based on 95th-percentile of batch seq lengths rather than mean to avoid regressions on mixed spikes.

Asha Patel (2025-11-21): Switched kernel hint to use batch_seq_len_p95 heuristic with a fallback to mean when sample count < 8. Docs clarified. Added integration test in tests/perf/test_dynamic_batching.py.
Samantha Lee (2025-11-25): LGTM after CI stabilized and small doc tweaks. Approving.
Miguel Ortiz (2025-11-30): Performance regression window shows no p95 regressions on long-seq-only workloads in staging. Approving and requesting squash-merge.
release_notes: Improved dynamic batching heuristics: adaptive quantile bucketing, intra-bucket padding minimization, and kernel selection hints. Expect lower padding overhead and reduced p95 latency for mixed-length workloads. Config flags: DYN_BATCH_SEQLEN, BUCKET_QUANTILES, PAD_REORDER_WINDOW.
benchmarks_summary: Mixed workload (60% short <32, 30% medium 32-128, 10% long >128): padding tokens reduced ~24%, p95 latency down 9-12%, GPU utilization up to 18% on average. Long-only workload: no measurable p95 regression (<1%).
notes_for_ops: Feature gated behind DYN_BATCH_SEQLEN; rollout recommended to 10% traffic for 24h with packing_disabled_high_kv_usage and kv_evictions_per_reorder monitored. Prebuilt tuning profiles available under serve/config/profiles/.
